about.title: About Marketing Tools
about.p1: Marketing Tools is a collection of free online utilities built for digital marketers, SEO specialists, and content creators. Every tool is designed to solve a real-world task — from building UTM links to validating email lists.
about.why_text: We noticed that marketers often jump between a dozen browser tabs to get simple things done. This site brings the most commonly needed utilities together in one place, with no sign-ups, no ads, and no data collection.
about.what_url: URL Tools — UTM Builder, URL Shortener, Redirect Checker, QR Generator
about.what_text: Text Tools — Diff Checker, Encoder/Decoder, Character Counter, Cyrillic Detector, HTML Editor, Transposition Tool
about.what_media: Media Tools — Image Resizer, Creative Preview, VAST Inspector
about.what_guides: Guides — Excel Macros, Image Resize Guide, Video Editor Comparisons, Marketing Dictionary
about.tech_text: Built with Node.js, Express, and EJS. All processing happens in your browser or on the server — nothing is sent to third parties.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collect_text: Marketing Tools does not collect, store, or share any personal data. All tool processing happens locally in your browser or on the server without logging input content.
privacy.cookies_text: We do not use tracking cookies, analytics scripts, or third-party embeds. A minimal session cookie may be set by the server for technical operation only.
privacy.third_text: This site does not integrate with any analytics, advertising, or tracking services. No data is sent to external APIs.
privacy.contact_text: If you have questions about this policy, please reach out via the About page.

macros.title: Excel Macros for Marketing
macros.intro: Ready-to-use VBA macros to automate repetitive marketing tasks in Excel.
macros.macro1_desc: Strips query parameters from URL lists except UTM tags you want to keep.
macros.macro2_desc: Combines rows from multiple sheets into one summary table.
macros.macro3_desc: Applies consistent formatting to all pivot tables in the workbook.
macros.howto: How to use: Press Alt+F11 to open the VBA editor, insert a new module, paste the macro, and run it with F5.

dictionary.title: Marketing Dictionary
dictionary.intro: Common digital marketing terms and acronyms explained.
dictionary.api: Application Programming Interface — a way for two software applications to communicate.
dictionary.bounce: The percentage of visitors who leave a site after viewing only one page.
dictionary.cpa: Cost Per Acquisition — the cost to acquire one paying customer.
dictionary.cpc: Cost Per Click — the price paid for each click on an ad.
dictionary.cpm: Cost Per Mille — the cost per 1,000 ad impressions.
dictionary.crm: Customer Relationship Management — tools for managing interactions with customers.
dictionary.ctr: Click-Through Rate — the ratio of clicks to impressions, expressed as a percentage.
dictionary.cvr: Conversion Rate — the percentage of users who complete a desired action.
dictionary.dau_mau: Daily Active Users / Monthly Active Users — engagement metrics for apps and platforms.
dictionary.heat: Highest Earning Available Tomorrow — a keyword bidding strategy for search ads.
dictionary.kpi: Key Performance Indicator — a measurable value that shows progress toward a goal.
dictionary.ltv: Lifetime Value / Customer Lifetime Value — the total revenue expected from a customer.
dictionary.ppc: Pay Per Click — an advertising model where the advertiser pays per click.
dictionary.roas: Return On Ad Spend — revenue generated per dollar spent on advertising.
dictionary.roi: Return On Investment — the profitability of an investment relative to its cost.
dictionary.sem: Search Engine Marketing — paid advertising on search engines.
dictionary.seo: Search Engine Optimisation — improving a site's visibility in organic search results.
dictionary.serp: Search Engine Results Page — the page shown after a user performs a search.
dictionary.utm: Urchin Tracking Module — parameters added to URLs for campaign tracking in analytics.
